lines.say: Ranking every way to revise maths. Don't come for me.
Rereading the worked solution. F tier. You're watching, not doing.
Watching the lecture back at double speed. C.
Ten of the same question in a row. B. Feels great. Won't last.
Explaining it out loud, from a blank page. S tier.
Spaced flashcards on the methods. Also S.
The app does both S tiers, on your own notes. Which one would you move?
